meta.description: Province ID map: the world raster split into PNG tiles (max 4096 px for phone GPUs).

projection.name: Miller cylindrical
projection.formula: x = (lon + 180) / 360 * width; y = (yNorth - 1.25 * ln(tan(pi/4 + 0.4 * lat))) * width / (2 * pi)

encoding.province: label = R + 256 * G (B = 0); province id = label - 1
